data.body:
rebar-debug final repair report.

Problem: ordinary structured replies emitted false `multiple candidates validated` warnings with semantically identical first/last values.

Proven root cause/proof: `_candidate_dicts` decoded an exact JSON object through both `_all_json_objects` and whole-text `json.loads`, producing two equal dicts. `_select_and_validate` constructed two equal-but-nonidentical Pydantic objects and used identity as the ambiguity test. Runtime probe: candidate_count=2, candidate_equal=true, validated_equal=true, validated_identical=false. This ruled out provider envelopes, model duplication, and retry aggregation.

Test: a parameterized held-out warning oracle covers one exact object and two repeated equal objects; the existing distinct draft/correction test is the negative control. Final oracle was RED first (2 false-warning failures, distinct control green), removed from the blind fixer’s worktree, then GREEN (3 passed). Reintroducing the exact duplicate-admission condition returned only the two identical cases to RED; restoring dedup returned 3/3 GREEN.

Fix: `_candidate_dicts` now retains the first value-equal survivor only. Discovery order is preserved; genuinely distinct candidates still validate in order, select the last, and warn.

Scope/safety: `parse_structured` remains the shared result/exception boundary; no caller depends on redundant validation or false warnings. The repair adds no dependency/config/capability and weakens no test. Focused structured/parser/adapter/verifier suite: 154 passed. Lint, typecheck (555 files), complexity, formatting, and diff checks pass.

Sibling/parity sweep: candidate aggregation in this parser is the only live structured-output source-merging seam. Native and prompted output, plan/completion/code-review contracts, adapters, and verifier integrations all converge on `parse_structured`; no MISSING surface. Sentinel authority, schema screening, tolerant repair, invalid-candidate handling, and last-valid selection remain covered and green.

Residual risk/prevention: the focused suite still emits the separately tracked upstream Pydantic-AI event-loop deprecation (`socialized-exclusive-mouse`), already blocked for a batched design choice; it is unrelated to this fix. The mutation-proven identical-candidate oracle prevents this false ambiguity regression.

Replication: the exact single-object response now produces one candidate and no ambiguity warning; two distinct valid objects still select LAST and emit the warning.
